model_output.cross_horizon_summary: The supplied evidence does not establish a sufficiently coherent net directional edge at any horizon. Strong 24h participation across observed altcoin capitalization proxies conflicts with latest-hour selling, ETH/BTC weakness, negative settled BTC ETF flows and contracting weekly/monthly stablecoin supply. Proxy transmission is BUILDING, not confirmed rotation or recovery. Near-term pullback risk is elevated, but that is not equivalent to a forecast of net decline. NO_EDGE does not imply sideways prices or low volatility. These are non-binding forecasts with no portfolio execution authority; the structural prior is context only.
global_missing_evidence: Canonical large-cap and broad-alt breadth remain UNCONFIRMED. Aggregate breadth and capitalization buckets share an upstream source and are not independent confirmation.
Small-alt coverage is limited to the Top-100 tail; microcap transmission is UNAVAILABLE and cannot be inferred.
No sustained price, ETH/BTC, breadth or dominance sequence is supplied. Zero changes since the prior packet do not establish persistence or momentum.
ETF evidence covers one settled session. Stablecoin deployment into risk assets is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Catalyst context is degraded. Macro observations are slow and asynchronous, without a supplied trend sufficient to establish an immediate directional impulse.
Live-anchor source-observation freshness is unavailable despite passing retrieval checks. Hourly funding-event rates are unavailable; live-anchor funding observations remain available.

contradicting_evidence: The upside case has substantial observed participation: 86% of the Top-100 proxy advanced over 24h, with a 3.33% median return and 70 constituents outperforming BTC.
The downside case has immediate selling evidence: BTC's completed-hour taker-buy quote share was only 26.9%, while BTC and ETH prices fell as open interest increased.
12h.expected_path: An uneven test of the recent rebound is more defensible than a clean continuation forecast. Latest-hour weakness permits a retest, while positive sampled spot microstructure and broad trailing participation permit renewed gains. The evidence does not resolve the net 12h sign.
falsification_conditions: Sustained completed-hour price gains, improving ETH/BTC and continued filtered-alt participation would replace the balanced assessment with an upside case.
Persistent aggressive spot selling accompanied by renewed price declines and weakening participation would establish a clearer downside case.
missing_evidence: A sequence of completed hours showing whether the latest selling persists or reverses.
Comparable-window order-book, taker-flow and open-interest observations; the supplied short trade sample and completed-hour measures cover different windows.
supporting_evidence: The latest completed hour was negative for BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC, despite positive trailing-24h returns.
Positive sampled depth and taker imbalances conflict with the completed-hour selling measures; neither window independently proves continuation.
BTC and ETH open-interest increases were small, and live-anchor funding was modestly positive; this does not establish a severe leverage unwind.

contradicting_evidence: A sustained upside interpretation is possible from widespread current participation: large-, mid- and small-alt proxy median 24h returns were all positive and exceeded BTC's return.
A sustained downside interpretation has observed liquidity headwinds: stablecoin supply contracted over both 7d and 30d, and the latest settled BTC ETF session recorded an outflow.
168h.expected_path: Recovery and failed-rebound paths both remain credible over the week. Current participation could develop into broader repair, but there is insufficient evidence that demand can persist against liquidity contraction. Neither a guaranteed late-week recovery nor a persistent decline is justified.
falsification_conditions: Durable price recovery together with sustained ETH/BTC strength, broader source-qualified participation and improving settled flows would establish an upside edge.
Persistent price deterioration, narrowing participation and continuing liquidity contraction across subsequent observations would establish a downside edge.
missing_evidence: Several days of price, relative-strength and breadth observations establishing whether the rebound survives retests.
Subsequent settled ETF sessions and stablecoin observations showing whether demand and supply conditions improve or deteriorate.
Source-qualified evidence of participation beyond the observed Top-100 proxies.
supporting_evidence: Strong current participation is only a trailing-24h observation and cannot establish a week-long recovery.
Longer relative performance remains uneven: only 17 of 49 Blockchaincenter constituents outperformed BTC over 90d; the published score was 35, versus CoinMarketCap's separate score of 46.
Stablecoin supply was nearly unchanged over 1d but contracted over 7d and 30d. One-day stabilization is not evidence of renewed liquidity expansion.

contradicting_evidence: The filtered large- and mid-alt proxies show strong upside participation: 82.4% and 85.7%, respectively, outperformed BTC over 24h.
The latest settled BTC ETF flow was -185.4 million USD, while stablecoin supply declined 1.52% over 7d and 5.28% over 30d, supporting a competing downside interpretation.
72h.expected_path: The key prospective test is whether the broad rebound persists beyond a single trailing-day snapshot. Consolidation or a renewed retest could precede either recovery or failure; the supplied evidence cannot reliably rank those outcomes over 72h. The structural prior's downside scenario is not independently decisive.
falsification_conditions: Persistent gains across successive observations, sustained ETH/BTC improvement and retained cross-cap participation would invalidate the no-edge assessment toward upside.
Continued price weakness together with broad participation loss and persistent adverse flow evidence would invalidate it toward downside.
missing_evidence: Multi-observation breadth and ETH/BTC persistence rather than another measurement of the same trailing-day move.
New settled ETF evidence and confirmation that available stablecoin liquidity is being deployed.
A settled BTC-dominance sequence; the supplied 59.6146% observation is a level, not a directional trend.

ETH outperformed BTC over 24h, yet ETH/BTC weakened in the latest completed hour, leaving leadership durability unresolved.
